coverage.why: All seven accounting areas and industry_lens carry findings and verdicts, the financial analysis answers every section plus dupont and path_to_distress, and input_manifest.json analysis_stages record no item dropped from either analysis after the gate feedback.

calibration.why: Each area verdict tracks its anomalies, e.g. cost_deferral's 'Clean on deferral' beside presentation-only items and revenue_recognition's 'A watch item, not an adjustment' beside the concentration and DSO items; the cash-flow verdict repeats the lease reading its own anomaly makes, which is itself unsupported.

valuation_reading.why: valuation.missing, market.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing leave no range, price position or implied growth, and the two assumptions named are ranked by scenario spread, not a calculator sensitivity; the reading says so rather than inventing them.
